summary: Backend + frontend testing for mTree UI overhaul (dark/gold theme), web admin dashboard, community-free flag, hold-to-confirm buttons, tab bar & admin-panel removal from mobile. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases PASS. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, dev-login token injected into localStorage.mtree_session_token): all 18 spec-features render correctly — home Sacred Commitment card, Notification Streak hub (streak-hub-card, HOLD TO MARK DONE / notification-streak-hold-done, Daily Ritual Streak row), HOLD TO START + Came True buttons, glass pill bottom tab bar with 4 tabs (tab-home / tab-ritual / tab-wall / tab-me), ritual tab combined 'Your Sacred Commitment' + HOW TO PRACTICE, community tab loads FREE with empty state (no premium lock), settings has NO settings-admin-panel testID, /admin route returns 'Unmatched Route', web admin dashboard at /api/admin-dashboard accepts MTree@Sacred#2026 and renders Overview/Users/Tickets/Pricing tabs with live stats. Admin config PATCH round-trip verified & flags restored to defaults (ads=false, subs=false, community_premium_required=false, prices reset). Deprecated packages check: none of the flagged expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch present in package.json (verified). Minor RN-web console warnings noted (shadow*, pointerEvents deprecation).

ui_bugs.issue: In the web preview, simulating a 2.2s mouse-down/up over the hold button did not visibly increment the Notification Streak score (0/63 before and after). The backend endpoint /api/manifestations/{id}/notification-response is verified working via pytest (score increments +1). This is most likely a React Native Web limitation for Pressable long-press via synthetic mouse events, not a code defect — needs manual verification on Expo Go / native device.

issues: Console warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated in React Native Web — main agent should migrate shadow style props to boxShadow or use platform-conditional styles.
Console warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated — should move to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Manually verify hold-to-mark-done score increment on a real device or Expo Go — Playwright mouse events cannot reliably drive React Native Pressable long-press callbacks. Backend already verified working.
Migrate deprecated React Native Web style props (shadow*, props.pointerEvents) to their new equivalents (boxShadow, style.pointerEvents) to silence console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is >1500 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, manifestations, admin, community, tickets) for maintainability.
Admin dashboard fallback path in get_current_admin also accepts ADMIN_EMAILS user session — verified this correctly rejects normal user tokens (403).
hmac.compare_digest used for ADMIN_PASSWORD comparison — good.
All admin config PATCH updates restore correctly and defaults preserved via DEFAULT_APP_CONFIG merge in get_app_config().
